slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: A producer would start with a script, a shot list and a continuity bible (character reference sheet, wardrobe, palette, lens and lighting per scene) before generating a frame, because AI video fails mostly on consistency between shots.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 4 of 9. Deeper, not bigger. What a pro would do that you didn't ask for. slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: ffprobe shows target resolution, constant frame rate and codec; ffmpeg loudnorm reports integrated loudness between -15 and -13 LUFS.
A second person checks every cut against the continuity bible and lists breaks.
